title: Night City Sandbox
description: Module-neutral sandbox used when no official adventure is selected. It provides persistent AdventureState without inventing canon.
premise: Open-world play in Night City. The World Engine determines local reality; the Adventure Engine persists facts, history, objectives and consequences created during play.
publicBackground: Night City is open for player-directed play.
gmBackground: Do not invent official-adventure canon. Treat this module as a state container for emergent play.

startDefinition.openingSituation: Begin at the player-selected or current world location.

gmGuidance: Use World Engine facts as reality.
Do not force a mission path.
Rules are resolved by the Rules Engine, not this module.
